sections.advice: Laugerie basse → Jurisdiction of Saint-Emilion is 114 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.
Jurisdiction of Saint-Emilion → Bordeaux is 42 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Bordeaux → back through Jurisdiction of Saint-Emilion is 42 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
back through Jurisdiction of Saint-Emilion → Laugerie basse is 114 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.

places-laugerie-basse-bordeaux.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the catalogued places the recipe names — a corridor between them, not a routed line. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.
places-laugerie-basse-bordeaux.story: From Le Bugue it runs 336 km to Le Bugue; allow about 5 h 48 of riding. It goes by way of Jurisdiction of Saint-Emilion, Bordeaux and back through Jurisdiction of Saint-Emilion. The line favours views over speed.
